import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

def task_func(myString):
    if not isinstance(myString, str):
        myString = str(myString)

    url_pattern = re.compile(r'(?i)\b((?:https?://|www\.)[^\s<>"\'\)\]\}]+)')
    candidates = url_pattern.findall(myString)

    url = None
    for candidate in candidates:
        cleaned = candidate.rstrip('.,;:!?\'")]}')
        if cleaned.startswith("www."):
            cleaned = "https://" + cleaned

        parsed = urlparse(cleaned)
        if parsed.scheme in ("http", "https") and parsed.netloc:
            url = cleaned
            break

    if not url:
        return "No valid URL found in the provided string."

    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()
    except requests.RequestException:
        return f"Unable to fetch the content of the URL: {url}"

    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")
    title_tag = soup.title

    if title_tag is None:
        return "No title tag found in the webpage."

    title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True)
    if not title:
        return "No title tag found in the webpage."

    return title
